Name: Animated Butterfly Hutches
Author: sproggen
Description:
This mod adds 10 animated butterfly hutches.

Included is two files for fast and slow versions, you can use only one, but for most natural results I always use a mix of fast and slow, as shown in the gifs attached to this post :)

*Requires Alternative Textures* - you can use the paintbucket tool in-game to mix-and-match different textures.

Hope you enjoy!

To install: Unzip into a seperate folder then drag the unzipped contents into your mods folder

Downloads.Description:
having both files is recommended - but not essential for functionality

having both offers more speed options, which makes the animations look more natural and varied when you have many active at once
